reference_provenance.pressure_tensor_and_sigma: src/tensorlbm/free_energy_stress.py (ludwig ludwig-cf/ludwig parity port: fe_symm_str / fe_symm_interfacial_tension)
reference_provenance.closed_forms: Swift, Orlandini, Osborn & Yeomans, Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 19 (1996); Briant & Yeomans, PRE 69, 031602 (2004): sigma = (2 sqrt2 / 3) sqrt(kappa A^3)/B, xi = sqrt(2 kappa/A), p_coex = A^2/(4B)
reference_provenance.mechanical_equilibrium: div P = 0 => P_nn = p_coex uniform across a flat interface (Rowlinson & Widom, J. Chem. Phys. 76, 1878 (1982) pressure-tensor form)

C1_coexistence_pressure.metric: relative error of the numerically constructed Maxwell coexistence pressure (Newton on equal mu and equal p0, no closed form) and of p0(phi_bulk) measured on the equilibrium field, vs p_coex = A^2/(4B)

C2_normal_pressure_uniformity.metric: max|P_nn - mean(P_nn)| / p_coex over the periodic domain (continuum limit is 0; measures spurious pressure oscillation at the interface)
C2_normal_pressure_uniformity.note: acceptance band for the discrete interface; the continuum value is exactly 0, so any finite value is discretisation error. Same band at every resolution (not tuned per case).

C3_surface_tension_from_pressure_tensor.metric: sigma_measured = 0.5 * sum_x (P_nn - P_tt) over one period (== 2 sigma for two interfaces) vs sigma_analytic

C4_lbm_mechanical_equilibrium.metric: time-stepped production free-energy LBM (Korteweg force), total normal pressure deviation max|P_nn^tot - mean|/p_coex and residual (spurious) velocity max|u|
C4_lbm_mechanical_equilibrium.note: |u|/c_s <= 0.15 keeps the spurious flow in the low-Mach regime the model assumes

verdict_rule: PASS iff C1, C2, C3 hold at every declared resolution and C4 holds at the production scheme (iso9); otherwise report per-criterion pass/fail (no aggregate cherry-picking)
known_limitations_declared_up_front: The curved interface (Laplace law delta p = sigma/R) needs the O(1/R) coexistence-composition shift and is NOT graded here; it is reported as a documented diagnostic only.

The production free_energy_step Cahn-Hilliard population is measured (not patched) for its missing -M grad(mu) flux; the phase field is held at the equilibrium profile during the LBM run, which is the standard static two-phase spurious-current test.
